column2: Bread dough rises because yeast makes tiny gas bubbles inside it.
column3: 麵糰會膨脹，是因為酵母在裡面製造出小小的氣泡。
column5: yeast 唸起來像「一勢」：一勢發酵，麵包就變大

column2: My aunt does yoga every morning to stay calm and flexible.
column3: 我阿姨每天早上做瑜珈，讓自己保持平靜又柔軟。
column5: yoga 像「有嘎」：身體有嘎吱聲，趕快練瑜珈伸展

column2: The factory covers iron roofs with zinc so they do not rust.
column3: 工廠在鐵屋頂上鍍一層鋅，這樣就不會生鏽。
column5: zinc 像「信」：信封外鍍一層銀灰色的鋅

column2: The doctor checked the child because his heartbeat sounded abnormal.
column3: 醫生替這個孩子檢查，因為他的心跳聽起來不正常。
column5: ab 離開 + normal 正常 → 偏離正常

column2: Grandpa is so absentminded that he often looks for glasses already on his nose.
column3: 爺爺心不在焉，常常在找早就戴在鼻子上的眼鏡。
column4: an absentminded professor (心不在焉的教授)
column5: absent 不在 + minded 心思 → 心思不在這裡

column2: The new library is easily accessible by bus and by bike.
column3: 新圖書館不論搭公車或騎腳踏車都很容易到達。
column5: access 進入 + ible 可以 → 可以進得去

column2: The plan has an accessory role in the project, so it can wait.
column3: 這項計畫在專案中只是附屬角色，所以可以先等一等。
column5: accessory 是配件：主角旁邊的小幫手

column2: She took an administrative job in the school office, handling forms and schedules.
column3: 她在學校辦公室擔任行政工作，處理表格和時間表。
column5: administer 管理 + ative → 跟管理有關的

column2: Our affectionate puppy licks everyone's hands when they come home.
column3: 我們愛撒嬌的小狗在大家回家時，會舔每個人的手。
column4: an affectionate child (充滿感情的孩子)
column5: affection 感情 + ate：滿滿的愛，像抱抱熊

column2: Soft drinks are fine, but alcoholic drinks are not for children.
column3: 汽水沒問題，但含酒精的飲料不適合小孩。
column5: alcohol 酒精 + ic：像酒的、含酒的

column2: The amiable neighbor greeted every new student with a warm smile.
column3: 那位和藹可親的鄰居用溫暖的微笑迎接每位新同學。
column5: amiable 像「愛咪」：愛咪咪的笑，和藹可親

column2: A good detective has an analytical mind and checks every clue step by step.
column3: 好偵探有分析的頭腦，會一步一步檢查每個線索。
column5: analyze 拆開來看 + tical：愛把事情拆解的

column2: The nurse said antibiotic cream would help the cut heal without infection.
column3: 護理師說抗生素藥膏能幫傷口癒合，避免感染。
column5: anti 對抗 + bio 生命 → 對抗細菌的

column2: This safety rule is applicable to every student in the lab.
column3: 這項安全規定適用於實驗室裡的每一位學生。
column5: apply 套用 + able 可以 → 可以套用上去

column2: Flight attendants and attendant staff stayed to guide the passengers off the plane.
column3: 機組人員與隨行工作人員留下來引導乘客下飛機。
column5: attend 出席，attendant 就是跟在旁邊的

column2: We stood on the cliff and watched an awesome sunrise over the sea.
column3: 我們站在懸崖上，看著海面上令人讚嘆的日出。
column5: awe 敬畏 + some：讓你「哇」一聲的

column2: Biological science studies plants, animals, and how living things grow.
column3: 生物學研究植物、動物，以及生物如何成長。
column5: bio 生命 + logical 學問 → 生命的學問

column2: The artist wore a bizarre hat shaped like a giant banana.
column3: 那位藝術家戴著一頂形狀像巨大香蕉的怪帽子。
column5: bizarre 像「彼扎」：彼此一看，扎眼好奇怪

column2: The bleak winter landscape was gray, empty, and very cold.
column3: 那片荒涼的冬日景色灰濛濛、空蕩蕩又冰冷。
column5: bleak 像「比力」：冷風比力氣還大，一片荒涼

column2: We took a brisk walk around the lake before breakfast.
column3: 早餐前，我們繞著湖邊快步走了一圈。
column5: brisk 像「布里斯克」的快步：清晨腳步輕快不拖延

column2: Pulling the truck out needed brute force, not clever planning.
column3: 把卡車拖出來需要的是蠻力，而不是聰明的計畫。
column5: brute 像「不入」：不入腦只靠力氣的蠻幹

column2: The captive bird beat its wings against the cage door.
column3: 那隻被關住的鳥用翅膀拍打籠門。
column5: cap 抓 (capture) + ive：被抓住的

column2: The charitable woman gave warm coats to families who needed them.
column3: 那位善心的女士把保暖外套送給需要的家庭。
column5: charity 慈善 + able：樂於幫助別人的

column2: Grandma has chronic back pain that keeps coming back for years.
column3: 奶奶有慢性背痛，多年來一直反覆發作。
column5: chrono 時間：時間拖很久的病，就是慢性

column2: The new medicine passed a clinical trial with two hundred patients.
column3: 這種新藥通過了兩百位病人參與的臨床試驗。
column5: clinic 診所 + al：在診所裡對真病人做的

column2: It was a collective decision made by the whole class, not by one student.
column3: 那是全班一起做的集體決定，不是某個同學單獨決定的。
column5: col 一起 + lect 選取：大家湊在一起

column2: Saying "gonna" instead of "going to" is colloquial English.
column3: 用「gonna」代替「going to」是口語英文。
column5: col 一起 + loqu 說話 → 大家聊天時說的

column2: Mina is very communicative and chats happily with every classmate.
column3: 米娜很健談，開心地和每位同學聊天。
column5: communicate 溝通 + ive：愛溝通的

column2: The two phones have comparable prices, so choose the one with the better camera.
column3: 這兩支手機價格相近，所以選相機比較好的那支。
column5: compare 比較 + able：可以放在一起比

column2: A comparative study of two teaching methods found small differences.
column3: 一項比較兩種教學方法的研究發現差異很小。
column5: compare 比較 + ative：用比較方式做的

column2: In the grammar lesson, "and" joins two coordinate clauses of equal importance.
column3: 在文法課中，「and」連接兩個同等重要的對等子句。
column5: co 一起 + ordin 順序 → 排在同一級

column2: She had cosmetic surgery to fix only the shape of her nose.
column3: 她動了美容手術，只為修飾鼻子的形狀。
column5: cosmetic 像「口試美的」：只改外表的美

column2: Taipei is a cosmopolitan city where people from many countries live and work.
column3: 台北是一座國際化城市，來自許多國家的人在此生活工作。
column5: cosmo 宇宙 + polite：全世界都是我家

column2: The old fence was crooked after the strong typhoon.
column3: 強烈颱風過後，那道舊圍籬歪歪曲曲的。
column5: crooked 像鉤子 hook：彎彎像鉤

column2: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel.
column3: 原油必須先精煉才能當作燃料使用。
column5: crude 像「苦路」：沒加工的原油又黑又苦
